name: com.ezg.voodoo-sdk
description: Editor automation for installing Voodoo's TinySauce publishing SDK (which bundles Adjust, GameAnalytics, the Facebook SDK and VoodooAnalytics) into a Unity project. You fill in one JSON config file with your keys and run a single menu item or batchmode entry point; the package generates TinySauce's settings asset, wires the Facebook app id and client token, creates the assembly definition the bundled GameAnalytics SDK ships without, declares the resource currencies and item types GameAnalytics requires up-front, adds the required scripting defines and scene prefab, and validates the setup. It also re-applies every compatibility fix automatically at build time — restoring Firebase Messaging entries that TinySauce overwrites in AndroidManifest.xml, qualifying tools:replace attribute names for AGP 8.x, stripping AppLovin MAX callbacks that GameAnalytics still references but MAX v13 removed, and priming Apple's Unity plug-ins so headless iOS builds link. Editor-only, no runtime code, no third-party dependencies.
